weather_report:
Late morning in Subiaco arrives bright and genial, the sky a generous blue with drifts of scattered cloud sliding lazily across it. Sunlight has a clean, silvery edge now, sharpening rooftops and eucalyptus leaves; the day looks clear and open, the sort that invites you outside but reminds you, too, that midday UV will be high and the glare unforgiving if you forget a hat and sunscreen.

Through the afternoon the pattern holds: sunshine most of the time, soft veils of cloud to take the sting out now and then. It reads as a pleasant day rather than a punishing one. Dress light and breathable, add sunglasses and a brim, and keep a water bottle near. It’s good weather for simple errands on foot, a quiet coffee at a shaded table, or letting a fresh wash dry on the line. If you’re out around early afternoon, tuck into the lee of shopfront awnings or tree-lined streets; later, as the light mellows, a gentle circuit of the neighborhood or a tidy in the garden will feel just right.
